external_authority.source: Jansen and Scheffler, Generalized coloring for tree-like graphs, Discrete Applied Mathematics 75(2):135-155 (1997)
external_authority.statement: List Coloring on partial k-trees is solvable in linear time when the number of colors is bounded by a constant.

external_authority.source: Hans L. Bodlaender, A Linear-Time Algorithm for Finding Tree-Decompositions of Small Treewidth, SIAM J. Comput. 25(6):1305-1317 (1996)
external_authority.statement: For fixed k, treewidth<=k can be recognized and a width-k tree decomposition can be found in linear time.

external_authority.source: Standard partial-2-tree characterization (Wald-Colbourn; later treewidth literature)
external_authority.statement: tw(G)<=2 iff G is a partial 2-tree iff G is K4-minor-free.

recognition.algorithm: Run a fixed-k treewidth recognition/decomposition algorithm for k=2.
recognition.positive_output: Verified tree decomposition of width at most 2.
recognition.negative_semantic_condition: tw(C)>2, equivalently C contains a K4 minor.

list_coloring.input: Exact lists L(v) subseteq [4] and a width-2 decomposition.
DP: For each bag retain proper list-respecting assignments that extend to the processed subgraph.
Introduce transitions add one bag vertex/color while enforcing lists and bag edges.
Join transitions combine child tables agreeing on the shared bag.
Accept iff a root state survives; store witnesses for reconstruction.
list_coloring.complexity: Linear in graph/decomposition size up to a constant depending only on k=2 and palette size 4.

certification.positive: Verifier checks width<=2 tree-decomposition axioms: every vertex appears, every edge is covered, and bags containing each vertex form a connected subtree.
certification.negative: A K4-minor model is four pairwise-disjoint connected branch sets with an edge between every pair of branch sets.

exact_use_condition: Residual connected component C is obtained after frozen fixed-boundary propagation/preprocessing.
All boundary restrictions are already encoded in exact lists.
tw(C)<=2 is certified by a width-2 decomposition.
applicability_to_C11_PI.conclusion: C is polynomially list-colorable without any general P7-free 4-coloring oracle.

C4_control.conclusion: The previously sealed T2 C4 is TW2_LIST_READY despite being cyclic and using all four colors across its lists.
